phases.title: Integrity foundation
phases.outcome: Open governance, schemas, claims policy, and a versioned evidence model.

phases.title: One reproducible baseline
phases.outcome: Candidate 000001 is represented, checked with exact arithmetic, cross-checked through a separate implementation path, explained, and fingerprinted.

phases.title: Benchmark ladder
phases.outcome: Candidate 000002 verifies one passport-bound constant linear coordinate map. Review corrections are addressed; qualified re-review and an outside reproduction remain open before a nontrivial sourced geometry.

phases.title: Public laboratory
phases.outcome: An artifact-driven evidence cube, candidate registry, result records, graph exploration, challenges, and reproduction workflows.

phases.title: Transparent search
phases.outcome: Compare random, evolutionary, Bayesian, and active-learning policies on frozen benchmarks.

phases.title: Federated reproduction
phases.outcome: Sandboxed community runners, signed manifests, cross-solver checks, and quality-based reputation.

phases.title: Novel research
phases.outcome: Only after benchmark success: novel candidate generation, expert review, and external replication.
